interface.shortDescription: OpenTelemetry workflows and local service controls for Codex.
interface.longDescription:
Splunk Observability Studio adds local OpenTelemetry audit, instrumentation, verification, Splunk publish workflows, and service controls to Codex.

How to get started:
1. Install the Splunk Observability Studio plugin.
2. Trust the SessionStart hook when Codex prompts you to review it. You can also review the Splunk Observability Studio plugin hooks from Codex plugin settings and trust the hook there.
3. Try one of these actions: open Splunk Observability Studio with $observer-open, check its health with $observer-status, audit this repo for observability gaps with $otel-audit, add instrumentation for selected findings with $otel-instrument, or verify emitted telemetry with $otel-verify.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repo for observability gaps.
Verify instrumentation and suggest GenAI telemetry improvements.
